headline: Nasdaq 100 Futures Rally After Semiconductor Valuations Hit Seven-Year Lows
summary: Nasdaq 100 futures rallied after a sharp decline in semiconductor stocks drove valuations to their lowest levels since January 2019.
why: The Nasdaq 100 index tracks the largest non-financial companies listed on Nasdaq, heavily weighting technology and semiconductor stocks that drive broader market momentum.

impacts.name: Semiconductors
impacts.why: Semiconductor stocks experienced a sharp decline.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Nasdaq 100 futures rebounded following a sharp valuation decline in semiconductor stocks, which hit their lowest levels since January 2019 amid AI slowdown concerns.
